summary: Iteration 32 — verified the UserManager wizard email-validation fix plus the create → reset-password → login E2E chain. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass (create user with only personal_email, email fallback, temp password, reset-password, login via pro email + personal email, wrong password 401, case-insensitive email, 4 seed accounts regression, admin RBAC 403). Frontend: all 4 requested wizard validation cases pass — empty Email pro advances to the HR step with NO 'Adresse e-mail valide requise' toast; invalid Email pro -> 'Email pro invalide'; invalid Email perso -> 'Email perso valide requis'; all valid -> advances. Full wizard save created the user and displayed the temp-password modal; row-menu 'Réinit. mot de passe' returned a fresh password and login with the new password via the PERSONAL email reached /dashboard with the onboarding welcome modal. Bug reported by the user is fixed; no functional regressions found.

minor.issue: weekly_hours is typed as str in UserCreate, so a numeric JSON value (24) returns 422. Frontend always sends a string so UI is unaffected, but the API contract is brittle — consider Union[str,int] coercion.
Returns the temp password in plaintext (expected for this mocked MVP); passwords are also stored plaintext in the employees collection.

issues: Date d'embauche / Date fin contrat / Expiration du badge use the native browser date input (placeholder shown as mm/dd/yyyy, US order) instead of a shadcn calendar — inconsistent with a French UI
Département/Manager/Type de contrat use native <select> elements rather than the shadcn Select used elsewhere
Password reset and delete use native window.confirm() instead of an in-app confirm dialog (also blocks automation and looks unbranded)
The reset temp password is echoed both in a 15s toast and in the modal — the toast leaks the credential onto the screen longer than necessary

action_items: Optional: accept numeric weekly_hours in UserCreate (currently str-only → 422 on numeric payloads)
Optional polish: replace native window.confirm for reset/delete with an in-app dialog; replace native date/select inputs in the wizard with the shadcn components
Optional: drop the plaintext password from the reset toast (modal already shows it with a copy button)
critical_code_review_comments: validateStep in UserManager.jsx (l.875-907) is now correct: personal_email required + format-checked, email pro format-checked only when non-empty — matches backend behaviour (server.py l.5698: email falls back to personal_email).
auth_login stores/compares passwords in plaintext (server.py l.5498). Acceptable for the mocked MVP but must be hashed (bcrypt) before any real deployment; there is also no brute-force lockout.
server.py is ~9.6k lines — should be split into routers (auth, admin_users, planning, messagerie...) for maintainability.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright note: reset-password and delete in UserManager use native window.confirm — you MUST register a page.on('dialog', accept) handler or the action is silently dismissed. Wizard flow: user-create → fields (first_name, last_name, personal_email, personal_phone) → user-next → HR step requires weekly_hours + Poste → user-next x3 → user-save; temp password shown at [data-testid=temp-password-value]. rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: validateStep required f.email (Email pro) even though the label had no asterisk and the backend defaults email to personal_email. The fix makes personal_email the only required email and format-checks email pro only when provided — confirmed by UI test (empty Email pro now advances to the HR step with no toast).
